wadl:method.name: GET
wadl:method.wadl:doc:
All publications can be obtained with above URI.

Sample output:

 <Publications>
     <Publication ParentID="Stibo Publication" UserTypeID="Default publication type" title="Publication1" ID="Publication1_ID"/>
 </Publications>

wadl:method.name: POST
wadl:method.wadl:doc:
Starts a background process that generates a InDesign package for an actual page.

Returns a 201 status code when the background process have been started and the Location field in the response header set to the URI of status call of the background process. The InDesign package is zipped and attached to the background process and can be fetched by fetching the attachment in the field ZIP. Note that if the DTP document that contains the actual page, contains more acutal pages, the InDesign package will contain all the actual pages in the DTP document

Sample output for Location field in the response header

/restapi/bgpinstance/BGP_16722/status

wadl:method.name: POST
wadl:method.wadl:doc:
Start a background process that generates a PDF of an actual page by calling DTP.

Returns a 201 status code when the background process have been started and the Location field in the response header set to the URI of status call of the background process. The created PDF is attached to the background process and can be fetched by fetching the attachment in the field ATTACHMENT_PDF

Sample output for Location field in the response header:

/restapi/bgpinstance/BGP16722/status

wadl:method.name: POST
wadl:method.wadl:doc:
Start a background process that creates a PDF of a planned page by calling DTP.

Returns a 201 status code when the background process have been started and the Location field in the response header set to the URI of status call of the background process. The created PDF is attached to the background process and can be from it by fetching the attachment in the field ATTACHMENT_PDF

Sample output for Location field in the response header:

/restapi/bgpinstance/BGP16722/status

wadl:method.name: POST
wadl:method.wadl:doc:
Starts a background process that generates a DTP document of the planned page.

Returns a 201 status code when the background process have been started and the Location field in the response header set to the URI of status call of the background process. The created DTP document is stored in the database and can be fetched by fetching the DTP document for the planned page.

Sample output for Location field in the response header:

/restapi/bgpinstance/BGP_16722/status

wadl:method.name: POST
wadl:method.wadl:doc:
Starts a background process that uploads a DTP document for an actual page.

The uploaded document will overwrite the existing DTP document that contains the actual page. This means that if the existing DTP document contains more actual pages all those pages will be overwritten.

It is not possible to upload a DTP document without having an actual page. Create the initial actual page by use the "Create DTP document for a planned page" REST API call or by uploading the document to STEP through a DTP application.

The post request is expected to be using the Content-Type multipart/form-data. The form should have two fields: pageID: The ID of the actual page file: A file containing the "content part" of the upload, that is containing the DTP document

Using curl the post command would look like:

 curl -u user:pwd -F "pageId=20104" -F "file=@aDoc.indd"
 http://serverURL/restapi/pblbackgroundprocesses/UploadDTPDocument

Returns a 201 status code when the background process have been started and the Location field in the response header set to the URI of status call of the background process.

Sample output for Location field in the response header:

/restapi/bgpinstance/BGP_16722/status

wadl:method.name: GET
wadl:method.wadl:doc:
Get all the pages of the DTP documents stored in the publication.

Sample output:

 <Pages>
     <Page Status="PlanningInProgress" DTPDocumentID="DOCUMENT_1" PageNumber="1" title="1" ID="5073"/>
     <Page Status="DTPInProgress" DTPDocumentID="DOCUMENT_2" PageNumber="2" title="2" ID="5074"/>
 </Pages>

wadl:method.name: GET
wadl:method.wadl:doc:
Get all the planned pages in the publication

Sample output:

 <PlannedPages>
     <PlannedPage Status="PlanningInProgress" SectionID="SECTION_1" PageNumber="1" ID="PLANNEDPAGE_1"/>
     <PlannedPage Status="DTPInProgress" SectionID="SECTION_2" PageNumber="2" ID="PLANNEDPAGE_2"/>
 </PlannedPages>

wadl:method.name: GET
wadl:method.wadl:doc: Get the saved DTP document of an actual page. The document is returned in a stream. If no document is found for the actual page, HTTP error 404 is returned.

wadl:method.name: DELETE
wadl:method.wadl:doc: Delete the DTP document that contains the actual page. If the DTP document contains more actual pages these actual pages are deleted as well. If a DTP document is deleted HTTP confirm codes 200 is returned. If no DTP document is deleted (i.e. the actual page and the DTP document is allready deleted) HTP confirm code 204 is returned.

wadl:method.name: GET
wadl:method.wadl:doc:
Get the actual page for a planned page in the supplied version. If no actual page exists for the planned page in the version HTTP return code 204 is returned.

Sample output:

 <Page Status="PlanningInProgress" DTPDocumentID="DOCUMENT_1" PageNumber="1" title="1" ID="5073"/>

wadl:method.name: GET
wadl:method.wadl:doc: Get the saved DTP document of a planned page. The document is returned in a stream. If no document is saved for the planned page, HTTP error 404 is returned.
